formRaceEntries.comment: Ran on well on the Hillside track before getting back too far at Flemington. Back in class & better ground helps.

meetTips.longComment: First meeting on the Lakeside circuit in a little over a month, with rail shifting back to the true position. Riders were happy to use plenty of the track in the home straight, with winners in lanes 3-11 at the 400m and 2-12 at the 200m. Three of the eight winners settled at margins of 3.2L, 4.6L and 5.7L from the leader at the 800m. All winners were within 2L of the leader at the 400m, and were all leading at the 200m.

formRaceEntries.comment: Jumped Ok seemed to get across ok to lead. under siege Turn Quickly Beaten awful. thrashed winner last time. vetted clear # too bad to be true
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Rdr said mount raced flat. Tnr expressed disappointment in performance of horse and advised horse had worked well and expected a forward showing. Post race vet exam revealed no abs. Tnr to report back.
